content.text: Image Viewer ​Win - People - TransformWho We Are​ How To Join ​​The United States Special Operations Command (USSOCOM) Army Reserve Element provides MOS-qualified and deployable Army Reserve personnel to augment USSOCOM, leveraging their military experience, applicable civilian skills, and rapid availability, in order to meet peacetime, contingency, and wartime requirements.Special Operations require unique modes of employment and equipment, tactics techniques and procedures. SOCOM develops and employs fully capable Special Operations Forces to conduct global Special Operations and activities as part of the J​oint Force.SOCOM works in support of the Global Combatant Commanders’ objectives and do so in concert with the U.S. Government Interagency, Allies and Partners, to support persistent, networked and distributed combatant command operations and campaigns against state and non-state actors to protect and advance U.S. policies and objectives.SOCOM ARE provides trained Reserve personnel to augment and fully integrate into the SOCOM headquarters, JSOC and TSOCs, leveraging military experience, civilian skills, and availability to effectively meet peacetime, crisis, and wartime requirements on a timely basis. Life in SOCOM is extremely busy. The world has not slowed down for SOF. SOF continues to provide unique access and placement that create options for the nation's leaders. ​Upon joining the ARE, Soldiers will attend the five-day Introduction to Special Operations Forces - Foundations Course before reporting to their directorate. Based on your MOS and position, there will be opportunities to attend additional JSOU or Foundry courses. For information on JSOU courses, check out https://www.jsou.edu/.​ Greetings from SOCOM ARE,It can be challenging at times being an ARE Soldier. ARE personnel provide crucial individual assistance to the Command, Agencies, and Directorates. Assignments are tailored to each Soldier's individual expertise and outlined in their YTP. The nature of this support demands attention to detail and flexibility in duty performance.​​​As a reminder, priorities are: - Duty Military Occupational Specialty Qualification (DMOSQ)​​- Professional Military Education (PME) - OER/NCOER - Medical Readiness- Yearly Training Plans- Tenure for ARE Soldiers is THREE years but can be extended to four or five years with an approved ETP.- Foundry a Department of the Army G-2 training program, led by the Intelligence and Security Command (INSCOM), that assists Commanders, and G2s by serving as the coordination point to obtain Military Intelligence training opportunities otherwise not available at the tactical echelon or through the institutional training system. The Foundry program is tasked to support the MI collective training environment, conduct advanced intelligence training, and intelligence community certification for the US Army.​​​List of Foundry courses can be found at the links below. below. https://ikn.army.mil/apps/IKNHostedWebsites/Foundry https://intellipedia.intelink.gov/wiki/List_of_Foundry_CoursesThank you. All SOCOM ARE positions are interview only. Please see the "How To Join" link for application information.SOCOM ARE is looking for NCOs, Warrants and Officers with diverse backgrounds, looking for a challenge. SOCOM ARE reviews ​prospect panels with directorates to fill current and projected vacancies. If you are within a 90-day window for transfer, don't wait, submit your packet today.​ ​ Upcoming Events The ARE team offers monthly AFTs at the MacDill Short Fitness Center the last WED of the month. ​Please contact SFC Juan Arboleda for scheduling and details.
